name: Restamenu Outbox Delivery
_comment: Reference export. Delivers transactional-outbox events to Telegram. Import, then: (1) create a Header Auth credential on the Webhook node with header name 'Authorization' and a random secret value; (2) set the Telegram credential + chat id; (3) activate and store the production URL/auth secret in Supabase Vault. The two Code nodes keep a bounded delivered-event ledger in n8n workflow static data. A retry after Telegram succeeded therefore returns 200 without sending a duplicate. Static data is persisted only for active production executions, so activate the workflow before verification.

Approved by: ' + text(p.approvedBy, 'Unknown'); } if (b.eventType === 'subscription.status_changed') { return '💳 Subscription ' + text(p.status, 'changed') + '
